verdict.rationale: Forter publishes a public API reference. It documents an Order v3 endpoint that returns fraud decisions, an order-status update API and an Evidence API for chargeback disputes, plus separate sandbox and production environments, so a programmatic or AI-native user can drive the core product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and documentation of authentication and rate limits in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Send order information at checkout to receive a fraud or abuse decision.
Inform of updates to the status of an order, including payment authorization, fulfillment, shipping details, and compensation granted.
Save time and effort by using our Evidence API endpoint to automatically send post-order evidence for chargeback disputes.
Forter has both a production and a sandbox environment for your development process.
they should call the Forter API with additional data, signaling Forter the transaction source as well as transaction metadata
